text:
The defendant is most likely guilty of murder in the first scenario, because she had a legal duty to warn her husband of the known threat and, with malice (hatred and deliberate indifference), omitted to act, causing his death. The second scenario more likely supports manslaughter or negligent homicide, since the defendant's allowing an intoxicated friend to drive shows recklessness but not malice aforethought.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
